scope: Correct the local numerical dependency configuration and require a thread-safe backend in build documentation. Production fit and generator algorithms unchanged. Historical calibration failures retained; acceptance thresholds remain provisional.

test_scope.rng_checks: Raw Philox streams, retained null scores, and E1 generated datasets compared exactly across 1/2/8/16 threads in release.

interpretation: The old serial backend corrupts concurrent well-conditioned solves independently of RNG or GLM convergence. Switching to pthread OpenBLAS with one internal worker removes the observed race symptoms. This corrects the earlier attribution of extreme parallel-fit coefficients solely to the count boundary. Native coefficient-based stopping still fails to stop on the limiting zero-count donor likelihood.
